name: Side-Lying Leg Lift
steps: Lie on your side with your body in a straight line, resting your head on your bottom arm.
Keep your bottom leg slightly bent for stability and your top leg completely straight with toes pointed slightly downward.
Engage your outer hip and lift your top leg toward the ceiling roughly 45 degrees, leading with your heel.
Pause for one count at the top of the lift.
Slowly lower the leg back down without letting it rest heavily on the bottom leg.
coaching_cues: Keep your top hip tilted slightly forward to isolate the gluteus medius and prevent hip flexor dominance.
Lead with your heel, not your toes, to keep the outer hip engaged.
Avoid rolling backward onto your glutes.
